display.title: Episode 235: The Two Brothers (Shiva Asar B'Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Before Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, Uncle Yossi explains that baseless hatred destroyed the Beis HaMikdash, then tells how two loving brothers chose the spot where it would be built.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the Tuesday after Yud-Beis Tammuz 5746. Uncle Yossi recalls the joy of the Frierdiker Rebbe's release, then turns to this Thursday, Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, when the siege of Yerushalayim began the Three Weeks that led to the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash. Our Sages teach that it was destroyed because of baseless hatred, so the order of the day is Ahavas Yisroel and unity, which will bring Moshiach and turn these sad days into Yomim Tovim. Since the holiness of Shabbos lingers into Tuesday, the Hakochainik march celebrates Yud-Beis Tammuz. After a sponsor message, a girl from Tzivos Hashem leads the Shema. Story time tells of two brother farmers, one with a large family and one with none. At harvest time each secretly carries wheat to the other's field at midnight, and they meet on top of the mountain; Hashem chooses that very spot, Har HaMoriah, for the Beis HaMikdash. Uncle Yossi closes by explaining the fast: children too young to fast should give tzedakah that day.
display.lesson: Hashem dwells where Jews love one another; baseless hatred caused the Churban, and Ahavas Yisroel will bring the Geulah.
